headline: K. Mitsotakis: National Success – Early Repayment of Debt, Fewer Burdens for Citizens
summary: Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis said reducing public debt is a national duty, marking the announced early repayment of EUR 13 billion within 2026. He framed debt reduction as easing burdens on citizens.
why: Greece's public debt is a central factor in its sovereign borrowing costs and credit ratings, which affect government bond yields and investor appetite for Greek assets.
